title: Famulus C5 tier policy
description: Permission/tier policy for famulus-agentd: a mandatory hard-deny path floor, an ordered first-match-wins list of tool rules, and a fully explicit default rule for unmatched tools.

version.description: Policy format version. This contract (contracts-v1, unchanged in contracts-v1.1) defines exactly version 1.

default_rule.description: The rule applied when no entry in 'rules' matches the tool name. All three fields are required here so the fallback is fully explicit.

hard_deny.description: Path-based denials checked FIRST and independently of 'rules'. Access to these paths is never allowed regardless of any rule. At least one entry is required; validate_policy.py additionally enforces the contract-mandated floor entries.

rules.description: Ordered list of tool rules, evaluated top to bottom; the FIRST rule whose 'match' glob matches the tool name wins.

tier.description: Permission tier: 0 = read-only/no-auth, 1 = user-authenticated, 2 = admin-authenticated. Carried on D-Bus as uint32 ('u').

behavior.description: What famulus-agentd does when this rule matches: 'auto-allow' runs the tool without prompting (tier 0 only), 'prompt' asks the user via the permission broker, 'deny' refuses without prompting.

requireSnapshot.description: When true, famulus-agentd MUST obtain a C4 snapshot (org.famulus.Snapshot1) before the tool runs.

autoAllowTierZero.description: Constraint: behavior 'auto-allow' is only valid at tier 0. Tiers 1 and 2 require authentication, so they can never be auto-allowed.

rule.description: A single tool rule: a glob over the tool name plus the tier, behavior, and snapshot requirement applied when it matches.

match.description: fnmatch glob (Python fnmatch.fnmatchcase: '*' any run, '?' one character, '[seq]' character set; case-sensitive) matched against the full tool name as the claude CLI reports it, e.g. 'Bash' or 'mcp__famulus_desktop__wallpaper_set'.

tier.description: Permission tier required for this tool (0, 1, or 2).

behavior.description: Behavior when this rule matches: 'auto-allow' (tier 0 only), 'prompt', or 'deny'.

require_snapshot.description: Optional; defaults to false. When true, a C4 snapshot MUST be taken before the tool runs.

reason.description: Optional human-readable rationale, recorded in the C1 audit log and shown in permission prompts.

defaultRule.description: The fallback rule for tools no 'rules' entry matches. Unlike list rules, all three fields are required so the fallback is fully explicit.

tier.description: Permission tier applied to unmatched tools (0, 1, or 2).

behavior.description: Behavior applied to unmatched tools: 'auto-allow' (tier 0 only), 'prompt', or 'deny'.

require_snapshot.description: Whether a C4 snapshot MUST be taken before an unmatched tool runs. Required here — the fallback must be explicit.

hardDenyEntry.description: A path glob denied regardless of any rule; enforced before and independently of 'rules' (by hooks/polkit on file-touching tool inputs).

path.description: Path glob the denial applies to. '**' spans directory levels; a leading '~' means the target user's home directory.

access.description: Access modes denied for this path. Unique, at least one of 'read' or 'write'.

reason.description: Human-readable rationale. Required for hard-deny entries because they override everything else.
